section_summary.extract_value: Abstract reports a Dutch translation and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 in a single sample of Dutch-speaking female university students (Study X; N = 310, Mage = 21.31). The Dutch BAS-2 showed a one-dimensional factor structure, good internal consistency (α = .90), convergent and incremental validity, and a qualitative negative association between BMI and BAS-2 scores (lower BMI associated with higher body appreciation).
section_summary.evidence_source: Summary based on: "This paper describes a Dutch translation and validation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2 ...). Dutch-speaking female university students (N = 310, Mage = 21.31, SD = 3.04) completed the Dutch BAS-2." and "Exploratory factor analysis revealed a one-dimensional factor structure... Dutch BAS-2 scores also demonstrated good internal consistency (˛= .90) ... In addition, lower body mass indices were associated with higher Dutch BAS-2 scores."
